adolescent behavior: Mood swings and arguing with parents are common adolescent behavior, so try to be patient with your teenage son.
情緒起伏和跟父母頂嘴是常見的青春期行為，所以請對你十幾歲的兒子多點耐心。
an adolescent crush: She laughed when she found her old diary full of notes about an adolescent crush on a pop singer.
她發現舊日記裡寫滿了自己青少年時期對一位流行歌手的迷戀，忍不住笑了出來。
an advanced course: After two years of basic French, Amy signed up for an advanced course to improve her writing skills.
上了兩年基礎法文後，艾咪報名了進階課程來加強寫作能力。
advanced technology: The new hospital uses advanced technology, such as robots that help doctors perform difficult surgeries.
新醫院使用先進科技，例如協助醫生進行困難手術的機器人。
at an advanced age: My grandmother started learning to use a smartphone at an advanced age, and now she video-calls us every week.
我祖母年事已高才開始學用智慧型手機，現在她每週都跟我們視訊通話。
advanced cancer: The patient was diagnosed with advanced cancer, so the doctors focused on reducing his pain.
那位病人被診斷出癌症末期，所以醫生們專注於減輕他的疼痛。
advanced countries: Many advanced countries offer free health care, and their people often live longer lives.
許多先進國家提供免費醫療，國民的壽命也往往較長。
adverse effects on health: Staying up late every night can have adverse effects on health, such as weight gain and poor memory.
每晚熬夜會對健康產生不良影響，例如體重增加和記憶力變差。
adverse weather conditions: Because of adverse weather conditions, all flights to Kinmen were delayed until the next morning.
由於天候惡劣，所有飛往金門的班機都延到隔天早上。
an adverse reaction to the drug: Soon after taking the medicine, she had an adverse reaction to the drug and broke out in red spots.
吃藥後不久，她就對藥物產生不良反應，身上冒出紅疹。
adverse publicity: The restaurant received a lot of adverse publicity after several customers got sick from its seafood.
幾位顧客吃了那家餐廳的海鮮後生病，餐廳因此受到大量負面報導。
an aggressive marketing campaign: The company launched an aggressive marketing campaign, putting ads for its new drink on every bus and TV channel.
那家公司推出了積極進取的行銷活動，在每輛公車和每個電視頻道上都打了新飲料的廣告。
an aggressive driver: An aggressive driver kept honking and following too close behind us on the highway.
一個開車好鬥的駕駛在高速公路上一直按喇叭，還緊跟在我們後面。
aggressive treatment: The doctors chose aggressive treatment, including strong medicine and surgery, to stop the disease from spreading.
醫生們選擇積極治療，包括強效藥物和手術，以阻止疾病擴散。
an aggressive salesperson: An aggressive salesperson followed us around the store and kept pushing us to buy the most expensive phone.
一個咄咄逼人的業務員在店裡一路跟著我們，一直逼我們買最貴的手機。
an agreeable climate: Many retired people move to the island because of its agreeable climate, which is warm but never too hot.
許多退休人士搬到這座島上，因為那裡氣候宜人，溫暖卻從不過熱。
be agreeable to the proposal: Most of the parents were agreeable to the proposal to start school thirty minutes later.
大多數家長都同意把上學時間延後三十分鐘的提案。
an agreeable companion: On the long train ride, my seatmate turned out to be an agreeable companion who told funny stories.
在漫長的火車旅途中，我的鄰座原來是個討人喜歡的同伴，講了很多有趣的故事。
agricultural products: Taiwan exports many agricultural products, such as mangoes, pineapples, and high mountain tea.
台灣出口許多農產品，例如芒果、鳳梨和高山茶。
an agricultural society: Two hundred years ago, Taiwan was mainly an agricultural society in which most people grew rice for a living.
兩百年前，台灣主要是個農業社會，大多數人靠種稻維生。
agricultural land: Large areas of agricultural land were turned into factories, so the farmers had to find other jobs.
大片農地被改建成工廠，所以農民們只好另找工作。
alcoholic drinks: Stores in Taiwan are not allowed to sell alcoholic drinks such as beer and wine to anyone under eighteen.
台灣的商店不得販售啤酒、葡萄酒等含酒精飲料給未滿十八歲的人。
a recovering alcoholic: As a recovering alcoholic, my uncle only drinks juice or tea at family parties.
我叔叔是個戒酒中的人，所以在家庭聚會上只喝果汁或茶。
be alert to danger: When you walk home alone at night, you should be alert to danger and avoid dark streets.
晚上獨自走路回家時，你應該對危險保持警覺，並避開陰暗的街道。
stay alert: Drink some coffee before the long drive so that you can stay alert on the road.
長途開車前喝點咖啡，這樣你在路上才能保持警覺。
on red alert: The whole city was on red alert as the strong typhoon moved closer to the coast.
強颱逼近海岸時，整座城市處於高度警戒狀態。
a mentally alert elderly man: Although he is ninety, my neighbor is a mentally alert elderly man who still does crossword puzzles every day.
雖然已經九十歲了，我的鄰居仍是一位頭腦敏捷的老人，每天還在玩填字遊戲。
an alien culture: Moving to a new country can be hard, because people must get used to an alien culture and a new language.
移居新國家可能很辛苦，因為人們必須適應陌生的異國文化和新語言。
a concept alien to us: Taking a three-hour lunch break is a concept alien to us, since we usually eat at our desks in twenty minutes.
午休三小時對我們來說是完全陌生的概念，因為我們通常二十分鐘就在辦公桌前吃完。
illegal aliens: The police found several illegal aliens working at the farm without the proper visas.
警方發現有幾名非法外僑在農場工作，沒有合法簽證。
alien species: Some alien species, brought in by ships from other countries, are now killing the native fish in the lake.
一些搭船從他國被帶進來的外來物種，現在正在殺死湖中的原生魚類。
